question.text: In performance attribution analysis, a portfolio manager overweighted the IT sector (portfolio weight 30% vs benchmark weight 20%) and the IT sector returned 22% vs the overall benchmark return of 14%. What is the allocation effect from the IT sector?

explanation.text: The Logic: Allocation effect = (Portfolio weight - Benchmark weight) x (Sector return - Benchmark total return) = (30% - 20%) x (22% - 14%) = 10% x 8% = 0.80%. The manager earned 0.80% extra by overweighting a sector that outperformed the overall benchmark. The Trap: 2.20% multiplies the weight difference by the sector return (10% x 22%). 1.60% uses benchmark weight times the return difference (20% x 8%). 3.00% multiplies portfolio weight by the wrong base difference. Note: Distributor/cross-exam framing removed; only the source-grounded attribution calculation retained.
